ine `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on t

ped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls). The fastest way to see whic
h step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404`: step verdicts still retu…\n- [Cancel a run](https://docs.m

g iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `grading` for its gating judge CAN be cancelled: it lands `cancelled` with no verdict, whi
ch is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run is alread…\n- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](ht

ope`, and becau…\n- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for
